Solution: Apple cost plus orange cost gives total spending. At most/no more than includes the upper limit (<=); the requested constraint is 2a+3o<=36. Object counts are nonnegative integers.

Question Choices: A system requires x + y >= 12 and x + y <= 8. How many feasible solutions are there?
Hints: The same sum cannot meet both bounds.
Solution: The same sum would need to be at least 12 and at most 8. Since 12 > 8, these conditions contradict each other. There are no feasible solutions.

Question Choices: A ball order has basketballs b and soccer balls s. At least 4 basketballs and at least 6 soccer balls are needed. Write the two constraints.
Solution: Each type has its own minimum count. At least includes the lower limit (>=); the requested constraint is b>=4,s>=6. Object counts are nonnegative integers.
